description: Adani Belrosa is an under construction residential project by Adani Realty at Adani Shantigram, Vaishnodevi Circle (SG Highway), Ahmedabad, offering 4, 5 & 6 BHK homes.

Simplex 4 and 5 BHK homes plus 5 and 6 BHK duplexes, the most exclusive address in the township. GujRERA RAA15538.
